Extracts article:published_time, modified_time, author, section, and tags

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.metadata.article.published_time.inspect
puts result.metadata.article.modified_time.inspect
puts result.metadata.article.author.inspect
puts result.metadata.article.section.inspect
puts result.metadata.article.tags.length.inspect
```
